name: Outer Membrane Protein Assembly (BAM Complex)
description: Outer membrane protein (OMP) assembly in E. coli requires the BAM (β-barrel assembly machinery) complex to insert β-barrel proteins into the outer membrane. OMPs are synthesized in cytoplasm, translocated through SecYEG to periplasm as unfolded polypeptides bound by chaperones (SurA, Skp, DegP), delivered to BAM complex (BamA + BamBCDE), and inserted into outer membrane. BamA is the central insertase, a β-barrel itself. The process requires precise recognition of β-barrel signature motifs and coordinated action of all BAM components. High AND gates for multi-protein complex assembly and sequential handoff mechanisms.
scientificAccuracy: Based on structural and biochemical studies of BAM complex. All components validated.
